name: u0life AI Assistant
author: u0life

sections.description:
u0life AI Assistant connects your WordPress website to u0life, a centralized platform for AI-assisted website tasks and multi-site project management.

Manage multiple websites from a single workspace: create tasks in plain language, schedule routine maintenance, organize website projects, attach files, and keep clear execution history. The plugin establishes a secure connection between your site and u0life to handle owner-approved tasks efficiently.

Key features:

  • Centralized multi-site management from a single dashboard.
  • AI-assisted task workflows and website routines.
  • Secure pairing and owner-controlled site access.
  • Task history, attached files, and detailed execution reports.

External service

This plugin connects to the u0life service only after an administrator enters a pairing code. The service is required to manage website projects, dispatch tasks, and view execution reports.

No connection is made before an administrator explicitly pairs the site.

Service: https://u0life.com/
Privacy policy: https://u0life.com/info/privacy/
Terms: https://u0life.com/info/ordering_rules/

License

This plugin is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress.org plugin directory.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Open Settings → u0life AI Assistant.
  4. Paste a fresh pairing code from the u0life website project and connect.
